const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
  <rect width="200" height="200" fill="#e5e7eb"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <rect x="40" y="50" width="120" height="90" rx="6"/>
    <circle cx="75" cy="85" r="10"/>
    <path d="M50 130 L90 100 L120 120 L150 95 L150 140 L50 140 Z" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="none"/>
  </g>
  <text x="100" y="170" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#6b7280">Image unavailable</text>
</svg>`

export const FALLBACK_IMAGE = `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`
